name: Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Elisabeth
beschreibung:
Scenic in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Elisabeth delivers comfortable living for outdoor enthusiasts. The well-equipped apartment features bright rooms and a balcony overlooking the Zahmer Kaiser.

Hikes into the Kaiser valley and trips to Kufstein Fortress or nearby swimming lakes are within effortless reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Elisabeth in Ebbs offers a restful getaway and mountain views in Kufsteinerland.
